# EV Charge Nepal

> Nepal-focused directory of electric vehicle charging stations with interactive map search.

## Site
- Homepage / map: https://evcharge.np/
- Cities: https://evcharge.np/cities/
- All stations: https://evcharge.np/stations/
- FAQ: https://evcharge.np/faq/
- About: https://evcharge.np/about/
- Contact: https://evcharge.np/contact/
- Privacy: https://evcharge.np/privacy/
- Terms: https://evcharge.np/terms/

## Notes
- Station pages follow `/stations/{slug}/`
- City pages follow `/cities/{city}/`
- Primary language: English
- Country focus: Nepal
